description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Ex-SOLDIER], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Dark)] and [Deathblow Materia Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ex-SOLDIER
description.text: Wind and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Spin Drive (VII) after using a Wind or Dark ability

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Deathblow Materia Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, keeps track of the number of Wind or Dark abilities used (0~4), grants [Deathblow Materia Mode Critical] to the user after using a Wind or Dark ability
